_: T-0019 / ROADMAP K58 — THE DECLARED COST OF THE FORB LATTICE'S CEILING.
flora.js deals the forb stratum on a lattice and gives a slot at most one plant.
The slot stands for 2.89 m2 of ground, so the lattice cannot draw more than 0.346
flowering plants per square metre however densely a community is recorded. Nine of
the ten populated forb layers ask for more than that, and their drawn density is
therefore a number TUNE.forb chose and not one any record states. z06_dense_forest
draws 0.5 per cent of what its own records ask for.
This file is the declaration. Every (community, side) the ceiling binds is listed
with the density its records ask for and the share of it the lattice can carry, and
`node tools/measure_sward_draw.mjs --gate` fails when the measured set stops
matching: a layer joining the clamp, a layer leaving it, the ceiling moving, or a
record's asked density moving more than half a per cent from its declared figure.
The gate is on the DECLARATION and not on the clamp, because the fault it closes is
silence and not size. A layer is allowed to sit on the ceiling; it is not allowed to
do so with nobody saying so. Both drifts that have happened here happened under a
green tree — K55 took the clamped count from four to six by fixing a unit error, and
T-0034 put the two prairies on the ceiling by dealing the forb stratum off the top of
each record's range instead of its midpoint. Neither showed up anywhere, because a
share reading 1.000 is one plant per slot whatever the slot is and a layer sitting ON
the ceiling prints exactly like one tuned to it.
K58's own figures are the midpoint ones and are superseded: it counted six clamped
layers at 44.545 (z06), 14.5 (z04) and 7.760 (z08, z10) plants per m2. Dealt off the
recorded upper bound, as T-0034 deals them, the same layers ask 66.381, 22.000 and
11.866, and the two prairies and the lakeshore join them. The marsh's WET side is
listed for the first time here: forbShareWet is clamped exactly as forbShare is and
nothing outside flora.js could read the density behind it until T-0019.
NOT A FIX, AND DELIBERATELY NOT. Raising the ceiling is more geometry in precisely
the communities that already carry the most, and the project's triangle ceilings are
breached on dev as this is written (T-0223, T-0229). The routes K58 names — a
per-stratum cell, more than one plant per slot — stay open and stay costed. Re-run
with --declare when a flora record moves, and let the diff be the review.
T-0282 ADDED THE STRATUM. As T-0019 wrote it this file listed forb layers only,
so the one thing it exists to prevent — a layer joining the clamp with nobody
saying so — could still happen one stratum over. flora.js deals the SHRUB layer
through the same shareOf against the same ceiling, and z06_dense_forest's shrub
records ask 0.403 clumps per m2 against 0.346: it had been on the ceiling since
K54 named it and the gate could not see it. shrubShareWet and shrubDensityWet
were not exported from flora.js at all. Ten layers now, of eighteen populated,
and the identity of a line is (community, stratum, side).
